title: Autonomized Admin Conductor: idempotent, auditable task orchestration for ops utilities
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight orchestration layer (Admin Conductor) that converts operator procedures into composable, transactional tasks with strict auditing and per-step ACLs. The Conductor focuses on: (1) deterministic dry-runs against a synthetic backend so engineers can validate effects without touching production, (2) transactional checkpoints and compensating actions so partial failures leave the system safe, (3) per-step permission scoping and approval gates to reduce blast radius, (4) span-level tracing and structured telemetry to tie every step to incident traces, and (5) a minimal REST/CLI API for use in the Console and adhoc operator flows. This ticket covers the core runtime, step schema, SDK hooks, and an initial canary rollout for the infra-oncall team.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Runtime executes a 5-step composed task with transactional checkpoints and either fully commits or runs compensating steps on simulated failures in dry-run mode
2) Each step emits structured spans (trace_id + step_id) visible in Grafana for latency and error breakdowns
3) Per-step ACLs respected: users without 'db_admin' role cannot execute DB-write steps (tested via unit + integration tests)
4) Dry-run produces deterministic, human-readable execution plan and a simulated changeset that matches production run results within 2% of ops metrics on canary runs
5) Console shows audit trail and links to the originating ticket/PR for every executed task
6) Canary rollout to infra-oncall with documented rollback and fail-open policy completed without customer-facing incidents
tasks: Spec: step schema v1 with inputs/outputs, compensation action, timeout, and required_roles
Engine: lightweight executor with checkpointing, in-memory journal, and persisted audit records
Dry-run harness: synthetic backend + deterministic randomness seed support
RBAC: integrate with identity service and per-step permission checks
Telemetry: span instrumentation + Grafana dashboard panel for step-level SLOs
Console integration: basic execution UI with audit timeline and approve/reject gates
E2E tests: chaos scenarios simulating step failure and compensating actions
Docs: runbook for operators + migration guide for existing scripts
Canary: deploy to infra-oncall workspace, monitor for 72 hours
